resources.string: Closes the apps you choose, and hides the YouTube Shorts feed.

FocusForge checks which app is in the foreground to show a pause screen for apps you choose. For YouTube filters, it checks YouTube screen identifiers to distinguish Shorts and supported feeds from ordinary videos. These screen checks stay on your device and are not retained or uploaded. It does not read messages, passwords or text you type. Chosen app names, pause decisions and their times are saved only on this device for Shield insights. Access is optional and can be turned off in Android Settings. The focus timer works without it.
